title: Einstein Plasma Sphere
description: A glowing plasma globe with bright pink, blue, and green electrical arcs radiating from a central electrode. Inside the sphere are two translucent human figures: Albert Einstein with wild hair on the upper left and a serene woman with closed eyes on the lower right, both intertwined with the lightning patterns.
